title: Daggerheart Loot lists file, version 2
description: Account lists as one JSON file, version 1 plus homebrew entries: an entry with source homebrew carries the item as a snapshot. The site writes version 2 only for an export that holds a homebrew entry, and reads versions 1 and 2. llms.txt, section "Lists as a file (import-v1)", subsection "Version 2: homebrew entries (import-v2)", describes it for AI assistants. Frozen: a bound may widen in place, never narrow; any other change is import-v3.json beside this one.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored on import.

format.title: Format
format.description: Names the file as a lists file.

version.title: Version
version.description: The format version this schema describes.

exported_at.title: Exported at
exported_at.description: When the site wrote the file. Ignored on import.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: The lists, each imported as a new account list, in this order.

name.title: Name
name.description: The list's name, in Unicode code points.

money_mode.title: Money mode
money_mode.description: How the list shows prices: in bags or in coins. See "Money" in llms.txt.

player_note.title: Player note
player_note.description: The list's note that players may read through a share link.

gm_note.title: GM note
gm_note.description: The list's note that only the GM reads.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: The list's entries in list order; an empty array for an empty list.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: One record in a list: a catalog record, or a homebrew item (source homebrew) with its snapshot.

id.title: Record id
id.description: A record id from catalog.csv; for source homebrew, the item key (hb_ and 16 characters of a-z and 2-7). A catalog id the site does not know is skipped on import.

name.title: Record name
name.description: The record's name, for a person reading the file. Ignored on import.

source.title: Source
source.description: official for a catalog record; homebrew for a GM's own item, which carries snapshot. An account that holds the key gets a live reference; any other gets a frozen copy of the snapshot.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of the record the list holds.

price_coins.title: Price in coins
price_coins.description: The price in whole coins, whatever the money mode; leave the key out for no price. See "Money" in llms.txt.

player_note.title: Player note
player_note.description: The entry's note that players may read through a share link.

gm_note.title: GM note
gm_note.description: The entry's note that only the GM reads.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.description: The homebrew item as a catalog record, with its source and the own cards it names. At most 131072 bytes of JSON.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.description: A homebrew item as the catalog draws it: the item's fields with its key as id, each name and description filled from the other language when it lacks one, its source with the section, and the set card and rule cards of its author it names. tier is the loot tier, or A on equipment only when eq.tier is A. A snapshot passes only whole: write it from the item, never by hand.

id.title: Key
id.description: The item's key, equal to the entry's id.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: item (kept), consumable (spent) or equip (a weapon or armour with eq).

en.title: English name
en.description: The item's English name, in Unicode code points.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The item's Russian name, in Unicode code points.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: A loot item's tier from its source book; on equipment only A, when eq.tier is A.

craft.title: Upgrades into
craft.description: The ids this item upgrades into; never the item's own key.

craft_from.title: Made from
craft_from.description: The ids this item is made from; never the item's own key.

set.title: Set card
set.description: The key of a set card of this file or the account, or a catalog set's key from data.json.

refs.title: Rule cards
refs.description: Keys of rule cards of this file or the account, or catalog rule card keys from data.json.

book.title: Source
book.description: The item's source; absent for an item with no source.

key.title: Key
key.description: The key in its author's account.

en.title: English name
en.description: The English name, the Russian one when it has none.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The Russian name, the English one when it has none.

section.title: Section
section.description: The section of the item's source the item is in.

key.title: Key
key.description: The key in its author's account.

en.title: English name
en.description: The English name, the Russian one when it has none.

ru.title: Russian name
ru.description: The Russian name, the English one when it has none.

cards.title: Own cards
cards.description: The set card under the item's set and the rule cards its refs name, of its author, by key.

sets.title: Set cards
sets.description: The set card the item names, by its key.

refs.title: Rule cards
refs.description: The rule cards the item names, by key.

snapshotSet.title: Set card
snapshotSet.description: An own set card as a snapshot embeds it: both names and both bonus texts, each filled from the other language.

snapshotRef.title: Rule card
snapshotRef.description: An own rule card as a snapshot embeds it: every field written, each filled from the other language, url possibly empty.

url.title: Link
url.description: The card's link: empty, or https:// and printable ASCII.

key.title: Key
key.description: A homebrew key: hb_ and 16 characters of a-z and 2-7. It names the object in one account and never changes; a key unique within its array. The site makes keys; a converter makes them at random.

relationId.title: Record id
relationId.description: A key of this file or the account, or an id from catalog.csv. An id that names nothing is kept and draws nothing.

eq.title: Stat block
eq.description: An equipment item's stats. A weapon (t weapon or secondary) holds cls, tr, rg, dmg, dt and bu; armour holds as and th. Write the tier from the source book; never work it out from the stats.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The tier from the source book, or A for an artifact.

cls.title: Class
cls.description: phy physical or mag magic weapon.

bu.title: Burden
bu.description: The hands the weapon takes: 1, 2, or any.

th.title: Thresholds
th.description: The armour's major and severe damage thresholds, the first lower than the second.

alt.title: Second stat set
alt.description: A weapon's second set of stats.

line.title: Upgrade line
line.description: The line the item upgrades along: a catalog record's line id (catalog.csv) or the key of the line's own first item. Every member of a line is of one equipment type.

stats.title: Second stat set
stats.description: A weapon's second set of stats, used in its other mode.

trait.title: Trait
trait.description: The trait the weapon attacks with.

damage.title: Damage
damage.description: The damage die and a bonus of 1 to 99, as d8 or d10+2.

damageType.title: Damage type
damageType.description: phy physical, mag magic, any either.
